# acloud_cloud_provider_availability_zones (Data Source)

List all availability zones for a given cloud region

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acloud_cloud_provider_availability_zones" "eu_west_1" {
  cloud_provider = "aws"
  region         = "eu-west-1"
}

output "zones" {
  value = data.acloud_cloud_provider_availability_zones.eu_west_1.availability_zones # ["eu-west-1a", ...]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Slug of the cloud provider, for example `aws`.
- `region` (String) Slug of the region, for example `eu-west-1`.

### Optional

- `organisation` (String) Slug of the Organisation. Defaults to the `organisation` of the provider.

### Read-Only

- `availability_zones` (List of String) Slugs of the availability zones in the region.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
